# Morphometic analysis
```{r, label="import spores",results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Import outlines: First list jpeg files to import

jpg.list <- list.files("outlines", pattern=c( ".jpg"), full.names=TRUE) 

# import them

spores <- Momocs::import_jpg(jpg.paths = jpg.list, auto.notcentered = T)
out_spores <- Momocs::Out(spores)
out_spores <- Momocs::coo_center(out_spores)
out_spores_scaled <- Momocs::coo_scale(out_spores)
out_spores_smoothed <- Momocs::coo_smooth(out_spores_scaled, n = 5)
# Ensure all outlines have the same number of points (e.g., 100 points per outline)
out_spores_interp <- Momocs::coo_interpolate(out_spores_smoothed, n = 120)
# Now apply Procrustes alignment
out_spores_aligned <- Momocs::fgProcrustes(out_spores_interp)
# Visualize to confirm
panel(out_spores_aligned, title = "Aligned Amanita Spores after Resampling")
efourier_spores <- Momocs::efourier(out_spores_scaled, nb.h = 10, norm = TRUE)
pca_spores <- Momocs::PCA(efourier_spores)

```
# clean pca data and prep for data merge - including merging all samples within species
```{r}
# Extract PCA scores and add species names if available
pca_scores_df_species <- as.data.frame(pca_spores$x)  # PCA scores
pca_scores_df_species$species <- rownames(pca_scores_df_species) # Add species as a column if not already
head(pca_scores_df_species)
write.csv(pca_scores_df_species, file = "PCA_Spore_Scores_Species.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}
# Standardize species names in PCA dataset (e.g., Amanita_abrupta_Bas_1 -> Amanita_abrupta)
pca_scores_df_species <- pca_scores_df_species %>%
  mutate(species_clean = str_extract(species, "^[A-Za-z]+_[a-z]+"))  # Extract genus_species

# Check results
unique(pca_scores_df_species$species_clean)

#write to csv
write.csv(pca_scores_df_species, file = "PCA_Spore_Scores_Species_clean.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
```{r}
# Remove the "species" column
pca_scores_df_species <- pca_scores_df_species %>%
  select(-species)

```

```{r}
# Add a column with the number of samples per group
pca_scores_df_species <- pca_scores_df_species %>%
  group_by(species_clean) %>%
  add_count(name = "num_samples") %>%  # Add a column named "num_samples" with the count of rows per group
  ungroup()  # Remove grouping after adding the count

# Check the updated dataframe
head(pca_scores_df_species)

```

```{r}

# Merge all entries under the same species_clean name and calculate the required statistics
pca_scores_df_species <- pca_scores_df_species %>%
  group_by(species_clean) %>%
  mutate(
    PC1_mean = mean(PC1, na.rm = TRUE),
    PC1_min = min(PC1, na.rm = TRUE),
    PC1_max = max(PC1, na.rm = TRUE),
    PC1_sd = sd(PC1, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    PC2_mean = mean(PC2, na.rm = TRUE),
    PC2_min = min(PC2, na.rm = TRUE),
    PC2_max = max(PC2, na.rm = TRUE),
    PC2_sd = sd(PC2, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    PC3_mean = mean(PC3, na.rm = TRUE),
    PC3_min = min(PC3, na.rm = TRUE),
    PC3_max = max(PC3, na.rm = TRUE),
    PC3_sd = sd(PC3, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    PC4_mean = mean(PC4, na.rm = TRUE),
    PC4_min = min(PC4, na.rm = TRUE),
    PC4_max = max(PC4, na.rm = TRUE),
    PC4_sd = sd(PC4, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    PC5_mean = mean(PC5, na.rm = TRUE),
    PC5_min = min(PC5, na.rm = TRUE),
    PC5_max = max(PC5, na.rm = TRUE),
    PC5_sd = sd(PC5, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()  # Remove grouping after summarisation

# Check the updated dataframe
head(pca_scores_df_species)
```

```{r}
# Remove columns named "PC#" (e.g., PC1, PC2, etc.)
pca_scores_df_species <- pca_scores_df_species %>%
  select(-matches("^PC\\d+$"))  # Remove columns matching the pattern "PC#"

# Remove duplicate rows
pca_scores_df_species <- pca_scores_df_species %>%
  distinct()

# Check the updated dataframe
head(pca_scores_df_species)

```

```{r}
# Save the aggregated PCA scores to a CSV file
write.csv(pca_scores_df_species, file = "PCA_Spore_Scores_Aggregated_with_Count.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```



# ADD THE NICHE TO PCA CHARTS 

```{r}
# Load the niche data (corrected path based on new upload)
niche_data <- read.csv("spreadsheets/species_and_feeding_type.csv")

# Check results
unique(niche_data$species)
```

```{r}

# Clean the species names in the niche data
pca_scores_df_species$species_clean <- str_trim(pca_scores_df_species$species_clean)
niche_data$species <- str_trim(niche_data$species)

pca_scores_df_species$species_clean <- tolower(pca_scores_df_species$species_clean)
niche_data$species <- tolower(niche_data$species)

# Add a new 'Ecology' column with "other" if no match is found
pca_merged <- pca_scores_df_species %>%
  mutate(Ecology = ifelse(is.na(niche_data$Ecology[match(species_clean, niche_data$species)]),
                          "other",
                          niche_data$Ecology[match(species_clean, niche_data$species)]))

# Check the merged dataframe
head(pca_merged)

# Optionally save the merged dataframe
write.csv(pca_merged, file = "PCA_Spore_Scores_with_Ecology.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```


```{r}
# import weather and geography data
weather_geography_data <- read.csv("Spore_weather_data_april28.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

```

```{r}
# Ensure both datasets have standardized species names
pca_merged$species_clean <- tolower(trimws(pca_merged$species_clean))
weather_geography_data$species <- tolower(trimws(weather_geography_data$species))

# Perform the merge, specifying the column names explicitly
merged_pca_niche_weather_geography <- pca_merged %>%
  inner_join(weather_geography_data, by = c("species_clean" = "species"))

# Inspect the merged dataset
head(merged_pca_niche_weather_geography)

# Save the merged dataset
write.csv(merged_pca_niche_weather_geography, file = "merged_pca_niche_weather_geography.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```


# Weather and PC1 and Shape analysis -----------------------------------

# TODO check why p value is different between scatter plots and correlation matrix

```{r}

# Load the merged dataset
merged_pca_niche_weather_geography <- read.csv("merged_pca_niche_weather_geography.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

```

```{r}

# Select only numeric variables for correlation analysis
numeric_vars <- merged_pca_niche_weather_geography[, c( "avg_temp_monthly", "Precipitation_monthly", "PC1_mean", "PC1_min","PC1_max","PC2_mean", "PC2_min","PC2_max")]

# Check for non number values in numeric_vars and handle them
numeric_vars <- numeric_vars %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(.)))

# Remove rows with NA values in numeric_vars
numeric_vars <- numeric_vars[complete.cases(numeric_vars), ]

# Verify that there are no NA values remaining
any(is.na(numeric_vars))  # Should return FALSE
```

```{r}

# Compute correlation matrix with significance (p-values)
cor_results <- rcorr(as.matrix(numeric_vars), type = "pearson")  # Use "spearman" if needed

cor_matrix <- cor_results$r  # Correlation values
p_matrix <- cor_results$P    # P-values

# Convert correlation matrix to long format
cor_melted <- melt(cor_matrix)
p_melted <- melt(p_matrix)

# Merge correlation and p-values
cor_melted$p_value <- p_melted$value

# Function to format p-values for display
cor_melted$significance <- ifelse(cor_melted$p_value < 0.01, "**", 
                           ifelse(cor_melted$p_value < 0.05, "*", ""))

```

```{r}

write.csv(p_matrix, file = "p_matrix.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}
# Create the heatmap with a white background and clear labels
Correlation_heatmap <- ggplot(cor_melted, aes(x=Var1, y=Var2, fill=value)) + 
  geom_tile(color="white") +
  
  # Add correlation values with significance markers
  geom_text(aes(label=sprintf("%.2f%s", value, significance)), 
            size=6, fontface="bold", color="black") +  
  
  # Improve color scale with better contrast
  scale_fill_gradient2(low="blue", high="red", mid="white", midpoint=0, 
                       limit=c(-1,1), name="Correlation") +  
  
  # Apply a white background theme
  theme_classic() +  

  # Titles and labels
  labs(
    title="Correlation Heatmap with P-values",
    subtitle="Significance levels: **p < 0.01, *p < 0.05",
  ) +

  # Improve axis readability
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1, size=20, face="bold"),  
    axis.text.y = element_text(size=20, face="bold"),  
    plot.title = element_text(size=20, face="bold"),  
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size=20, face="italic"),  # Subtitle explaining asterisks
    plot.caption = element_text(size=20, face="italic"),  # Caption for p-value significance
    legend.text = element_text(size=20),  
    legend.title = element_text(size=20, face="bold"),
    
    # Ensure panel background is completely white
    panel.background = element_rect(fill="white", color=NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill="white", color=NA)
  )

```

```{r}

# Save the plot
ggsave("Correlation_heatmap.png",
       plot = Correlation_heatmap, width = 20, height = 20, dpi = 300)

```

# Precipitation vs pc1

```{r}

# Compute Pearson correlation and get the p-value
cor_test <- rcorr(as.matrix(merged_pca_niche_weather_geography[, c("Precipitation_monthly", "PC1_mean")]), type = "pearson")
p_value_pc1_precip <- cor_test$P[1,2]  # Extract p-value

# Convert p-value to formatted string for display
p_label <- paste("p =", format.pval(p_value_pc1_precip, digits = 3, scientific = TRUE))

```

```{r}
# Scatter plot: Precipitation vs PC1_mean with points colored by Ecology
scatter_plot <- ggplot(merged_pca_niche_weather_geography, 
                       aes(x = Precipitation_monthly, y = PC1_mean, color = Ecology)) +
  
  # Make dot sizes more dramatic
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 3) +
  
  # Add regression line with confidence interval
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red", se = TRUE, linetype = "dashed", fill = "grey70") +

  # Add p-value annotation on the plot
  annotate("text", 
           x = max(merged_pca_niche_weather_geography$Precipitation_monthly) * 0.9,  # Adjust x to 90% of max
           y = max(merged_pca_niche_weather_geography$PC1_mean) * 0.9,  # Adjust y to 90% of max
           label = p_label, size = 10, fontface = "bold", color = "red") +

  # Titles and labels
  labs(
    title = "Precipitation Monthly vs PC1",
    x = "Precipitation (in)",
    y = "PC1 Mean Score",
    color = "Ecology"  # Legend title for color
  ) +

  # Customize colors for Ecology categories
  scale_color_manual(values = c("ectomycorrhizal" = "green", "lepidella" = "orange")) +

  # Theme adjustments for readability
  theme_classic(base_size = 24) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 24, face = "italic"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",  # Place legend on the right
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )
  
```

```{r}

# Save the plot with adjusted dimensions
ggsave("Precipitation_vs_PC1_colored_by_Ecology_fixed.png", 
       plot = scatter_plot, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 400)

# Print plot
print(scatter_plot)
```


# lepidella vs ectomycorrhizal
```{r}
# Filter the dataset to include only "lepidella"
merged_pca_niche_weather_geography_lepidella <- merged_pca_niche_weather_geography %>%
  filter(Ecology %in% c( "lepidella"))

# Compute Pearson correlation and get the p-value for the filtered data
cor_test_filtered <- rcorr(as.matrix(merged_pca_niche_weather_geography_lepidella[, c("Precipitation_monthly", "PC1_mean")]), type = "pearson")
p_value_filtered <- cor_test_filtered$P[1, 2]  # Extract p-value

# Convert p-value to formatted string for display
p_label_filtered <- paste("p =", format.pval(p_value_filtered, digits = 3, scientific = TRUE))

# Print the p-value
print(p_label_filtered)

```

```{r}

# Scatter plot: Precipitation vs PC1 with points colored by Ecology
scatter_plot <- ggplot(merged_pca_niche_weather_geography_lepidella, 
                       aes(x = Precipitation_monthly, y = PC1_mean, color = Ecology)) +
  
  # Make dot sizes more dramatic
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 3) +
  
  # Add regression line with confidence interval
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red", se = TRUE, linetype = "dashed", fill = "grey70") +

  # Add p-value annotation on the plot
  annotate("text", x = max(merged_pca_niche_weather_geography_lepidella$Precipitation_monthly) - 1, 
           y = max(merged_pca_niche_weather_geography_lepidella$PC1_mean), 
           label = p_label_filtered, size = 6, fontface = "bold", color = "red") +

  # Titles and labels
  labs(
    title = "Precipitation Monthly vs PC1",
    x = "Precipitation (in)",
    y = "PC1 Score",
    color = "Ecology"  # Legend title for color
  ) +

    # Customize colors for Ecology categories
  scale_color_manual(values = c( "lepidella" = "orange")) +
  
  # Theme adjustments for readability
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, face = "italic"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",  # Place legend on the right
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

# Save the plot
ggsave("Precipitation_vs_PC1_colored_by_Ecology_lepidella.png", plot = scatter_plot, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# Print plot
print(scatter_plot)


```
